cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've released the gallery from hosting my exhibition. They need room for smaller ambitions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected us. Shall I collect your paintings?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. Withdrawing my best work gives them space to recover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already put it outside. I'll bring the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'm conceding the pavement too. No need to overshadow their entrance.
